## What it is

A personal portfolio landing page for **Ihor Lialiuk** (Frontend Developer at RED Solutions). Self-contained HTML — inline CSS only, fonts pulled from Google Fonts (`Outfit` + `JetBrains Mono`).

Per the most recent commit (`1916639`), this landing was redesigned with real GitHub data, outline SVG icons, and Unsplash project photos.

## Style / approach

- **Dark, cool-toned palette:** `--bg-0: #08090d` through `--bg-3: #1a1d28`, with subtle white card overlays (`rgba(255,255,255,0.025)`).
- **Accent system:** electric indigo (`#818cf8`) primary, warm coral (`#fb7185`) secondary, mint tertiary.
- **Typography:** `Outfit` (300–900 weights) for UI, `JetBrains Mono` for code/labels.
- **Heavy use of CSS custom properties** for tokens (colors, borders, accent glows) — the most design-system-mature file in the repo after pong-game.
- Real assets: GitHub project data, Unsplash photography, outline SVG icons (no emoji).
- Targets 2025/26 UI/UX conventions (per commit message).
